headlines.title: Seagate’s Legitimacy as a Play on AI Hardware Demand is About To Be Tested
headlines.summary: Seagate beat earnings for the sixth straight quarter, yet its shares sank 20% within a week and still trade at a bargain multiple. What are investors seeing in those hard drives that Wall Street's bulls are missing?

headlines.title: Seagate Technology Holdings (STX) Gains Fresh Backing As AI Storage Demand Tests Its Valuation
headlines.summary: Seagate Technology Holdings (STX) is back in focus after a sharp move tied to stronger fiscal guidance, fresh AI driven storage demand, and the launch of its Alkemi powered FireCuda Forge drive. The latest jump in Seagate Technology Holdings’ share price, with a 1 day share price return of about 10%, comes after weeks of pressure that left the 30 day share price return down 27% and the 90 day share price return down 40%.

headlines.title: Morgan Stanley sees 129% tech company rebound brewing after crash
headlines.summary: Sales are up 61%, yet the Seagate stock has fallen 43% in three months. Here’s what’s behind the disconnect.

headlines.title: Seagate Expands Storage Portfolio With FireCuda Forge Launch
headlines.summary: STX expands its storage portfolio with FireCuda Forge, combining SSD speed and HDD capacity as demand for high-capacity storage solutions continues to grow.

headlines.title: Seagate Soars 10% as CoreWeave’s “Breakout Quarter” Eases AI Spending Fears
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysSeagate shares rose 10% today after CoreWeave beat estimates and raised its 2026 guidance. The selloff in Seagate and Western Digital went well beyond any slowdown in AI storage demand.

description: Seagate Technology Holdings plc engages in providing data storage solutions in Singapore, the United States, the Netherlands, and internationally. The company offers External and internal hard drives; external and internal solid-state drives (SSDs); enterprise hard drives and SSDs; data storage systems; network attached storage (NAS) hard drives; video and analytics hard drives; and hyperscale and cloud solution. It offers its products for Healthcare, Media & Entertainment, Surveillance & Security, and telecommunication industry. The company sells its products primarily to original equipment manufacturers, distributors, and retailers. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Singapore.
